text:

title: Nu Nu Tun
Resume
text:
PMP® certified Senior System Analyst with over 10 years of experience in designing and developing enterprise systems across finance, property, and semiconductor industries. Currently pursuing an MBA at University Canada West, with a passion for strategic technology solutions and digital transformation.




Senior Software Engineer
Alphawave Technology, Singapore (May 2022 – Mar 2024)
- Migrated legacy systems to modern C#, MSSQL, AngularJS stack
- Led deployment and user training for Property Accounting System
- Delegated tasks and mentored junior developers
- Provided ongoing customer support and logged resolutions
Senior Analyst Programmer
Aspial Corporation, Singapore (Jul 2020 – May 2022)
- Migrated internal Inventory Management System
- Participated in design and requirement gathering with international vendors
- Ensured user satisfaction through smooth deployment
Senior System Analyst
Japan Research Institute, Singapore (Jul 2016 – Jul 2020)
- Delivered KYC systems for SMBC Bank across APAC
- Built web apps with .NET C#, MSSQL, JavaScript
- Led SIT and regression testing coordination
- Managed release documentation and stakeholder expectations
Senior Analyst
WD Media Singapore (Mar 2013 – Jul 2016)
- Implemented dashboards with .NET C#, Silverlight, and Telerik
- Built systems supporting 24/7 factory operations
- Managed project timelines and transitioned from vendor to internal role
Programmer
ASE Singapore (Apr 2011 – Aug 2012)
- Developed B2B applications for semiconductor data delivery
- Improved existing systems for better performance and maintainability





MBA (In Progress) – University Canada West, Vancouver BC

Master of Technology in Knowledge Engineering – National University of Singapore (2014)

Postgraduate Diploma in System Analysis – National University of Singapore (2011)

Bachelor of Computer Science – University of Computer Studies, Yangon (2005)






PMP® Certified – Project Management Institute (2020–2026)






Programming: C#, .NET, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL

Databases: SQL Server, MSSQL

Tools: AngularJS, Telerik, Tableau, Git, Power BI

Other: Requirements Gathering, SDLC, System Design, Project Management
